# Ashish Katoch — Frontend Engineer

> Frontend Engineer with 8+ years building React.js and Next.js applications. Based in Mohali, India. Available for freelance and full-time roles.

## About

Ashish Katoch is a Frontend Engineer specializing in React.js, Next.js, and TypeScript. With 8+ years of experience, he has built responsive, scalable web applications for clients including Sobeys, Safeway, Kiehl's, and Polín et moi. He holds degrees from Lovely Professional University and Himachal Pradesh University.

## Services

- React.js / Next.js development
- Frontend architecture and code review
- Performance and accessibility audits
- Design-to-code implementation
